changeSet.author: minisandmore
changeSet.comment: Backfill compare_at_price on simple products from price
changeSet.sql: UPDATE product SET compare_at_price = price WHERE (compare_at_price IS NULL OR compare_at_price <= 0) AND price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND ( variants_json IS NULL OR btrim(variants_json) = '' OR btrim(variants_json) = '[]' OR upper(coalesce(item_structure, 'SIMPLE')) = 'SIMPLE' );

changeSet.author: minisandmore
changeSet.comment: Backfill variant mrp in variants_json when missing (legacy rate-only rows)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE product p SET variants_json = ( SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN coalesce(nullif(elem->>'mrp', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 THEN elem WHEN coalesce(nullif(elem->>'price', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 THEN elem || jsonb_build_object('mrp', (elem->>'price')::numeric) WHEN coalesce(nullif(elem->>'rate', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 THEN elem || jsonb_build_object('mrp', (elem->>'rate')::numeric) ELSE elem END ORDER BY ord ), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.variants_json::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, ord) ) WHERE variants_json IS NOT NULL AND btrim(variants_json) NOT IN ('', '[]') AND upper(coalesce(item_structure, '')) = 'VARIANTS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.variants_json::jsonb) elem WHERE coalesce(nullif(elem->>'mrp', '')::numeric, 0) <= 0 AND ( coalesce(nullif(elem->>'rate', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 OR coalesce(nullif(elem->>'price', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 ) );

changeSet.author: minisandmore
changeSet.comment: Set parent compare_at_price from min active variant mrp
changeSet.sql: UPDATE product p SET compare_at_price = agg.min_mrp FROM ( SELECT pr.id, min((elem->>'mrp')::numeric) AS min_mrp FROM product pr CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(pr.variants_json::jsonb) AS elem WHERE pr.variants_json IS NOT NULL AND btrim(pr.variants_json) NOT IN ('', '[]') AND upper(coalesce(pr.item_structure, '')) = 'VARIANTS' AND coalesce(elem->>'active', 'true') NOT IN ('false', '0') AND coalesce(nullif(elem->>'mrp', '')::numeric, 0) > 0 GROUP BY pr.id ) agg WHERE p.id = agg.id AND (p.compare_at_price IS NULL OR p.compare_at_price <= 0);

changeSet.author: minisandmore
changeSet.comment: Fallback parent compare_at_price from price for variant products still missing MRP
changeSet.sql: UPDATE product SET compare_at_price = price WHERE (compare_at_price IS NULL OR compare_at_price <= 0) AND price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND variants_json IS NOT NULL AND btrim(variants_json) NOT IN ('', '[]') AND upper(coalesce(item_structure, '')) = 'VARIANTS';
